title: How to automate AI image generation with your AI agent and Zapier
summary: Your AI agent can already write a prompt, generate an image, and suggest ten variations. The trouble is that the image stays in the chat. Someone still has to download it, rename it, drop it into the brief, and send it to the person who asked. You can set all of that up from the AI tool you already use. Install Zapier in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor, tell your agent where image requests come from and where the finished images should land, and it builds the Zap for you. Zapier runs it from there, e
